facts.fact: 艾勒尼把朱迪思带进自己的酒店房间，用衣柜里藏着的保险箱取出文件
facts.anchor: a safe that was hidden within the built-in wardrobe

facts.fact: 朱迪思认出自己手里是菲利波斯死后她提交的那份证人陈述副本
facts.anchor: She was holding a copy of the witness statement that she’d given following Philippos’s death.

facts.fact: 艾勒尼说自己有一位警界朋友，是文件的来源
facts.anchor: I have a friend in the police

facts.fact: 艾勒尼逐条宣读证词，指出朱迪思曾告诉菲利波斯风暴将至
facts.anchor: It says you told my father that a storm was coming in, but he wouldn’t listen to you.

facts.fact: 朱迪思回想菲利波斯动怒的缘由
facts.anchor: His temper when he felt he wasn’t as clever as her.

facts.fact: 艾勒尼又拿出一张菲利波斯家下方海湾的旧照片
facts.anchor: It showed the cove beneath Philippos’s house.

facts.fact: 朱迪思认出照片里的裙子正是菲利波斯死去那天她穿的那一件
facts.anchor: she’d never forget that the day he’d died was the first time that she’d worn the dress she was wearing in the photograph.

facts.fact: 艾勒尼开出条件：要么去自首，要么她把全部证据交给警方
facts.anchor: You go to the police and confess the truth of what happened that day, or I’ll give them all the evidence I’ve got.

facts.fact: 结尾处朱迪思独自承认自己那份证词一直是谎话
facts.anchor: as only Judith had known for the last forty-nine years, it had been a lie.
